About the Product

Item 2749562

What it is: A pigmented, silky satin-matte-finish lipstick that is lightweight and comfortable.


Formulation Type: Lipstick


Benefits: Hydrating, Long-wearing


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Hyaluronic Acid: Offers up to 24-hour preserved hydration.

- Silk Powder Extract: Provides comfortable texture.

- Pear Oil: Glides smoothly on the lips.


What Else You Need to Know: Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk Satin Matte Lipstick includes hyaluronic acid, which offers up to 24-hour preserved hydration to the lips, silk-powder extract to provide comfortable texture, and pear oil to help the lip color glide smoothly.* This lip color has intense pigmentation with just one swipe and long-lasting wear, staying vibrant for up to 12 hours.** (*Instrumental test on 25 volunteers. **Instrumental test on 24 volunteers.)


Clinical Results: Tested at least once a day on 104 women from 20 to 45 years old during 1 week of use:

- 99% found the color to be intense in just one stroke

- 92% reported that their lips seemed protected

- 93% felt that their lips looked smoother

-Hyaluronic Acid: Provides up to 24 hours of hydration and moisturizes lips.
-Jojoba Seed Extract: Nourishes lips.
-Acmella oleracea Extract: Smooths lips.

Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate, Bisbehenyl/Isostearyl/Phytosteryl Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Hydrogenated Castor Oil Dimer Dilinoleate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Wax, Octyldodecanol, Squalane, Jojoba Esters, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Cera Alba (Beeswax), Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Wax, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Parfum (Fragrance), Diisostearyl Malate, Trimethylolpropane Triisostearate, Trihydroxystearin, Tocopherol, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Acmella Oleracea Extract, Pearl Powder, Sodium Hyaluronate, Propyl Gallate, [+/- CI 77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 45380 (Red 21)].
Suggested Usage:
-Start by applying to the upper lip, outlining the Cupid’s bow, and then continue with the lower lip.
-To accentuate the blurred effect, lightly blot by gently tapping with your finger.

Givenchy’s ultimate lip routine:
-Apply Le Rouge Baume (sold separately), which envelops the lips in up to 24 hours of hydration and has 96 percent natural-origin ingredients.
-Blot away any excess before applying Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk Satin Matte Lipstick.

Ever since the days when couture was considered a refined, white-coated craftsmanship, Hubert de Givenchy has been recognized as one of the world's most revered fashion designers—with a client roster that reads like a 'who's who' of the best-dressed women of all time. Givenchy's fragrances, cosmetics, and advanced skincare are as precious as couture—with seemingly personalized formulas that are modern in innovation and high in performance. They're a blend of French-style elegance with American-style spontaneity, plus a touch of something very chic, very irresistible, and very Givenchy.
